name: Integrated Capital Services Limited
about: Integrated Capital Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of advisory and consulting services in India and internationally. The company offers corporate advisory, consulting, and expert services in the areas of turnaround and restructuring, business combinations, takeovers, mergers and amalgamations, and accounting services. It also provides advisory, compliance, and representation services to on-going/new businesses; business consolidation/restructuring services; and advisory, setting-up, and implementing accounting systems. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New Delhi, India.
